title: Building Software at Google Scale Tech Talk
summary: Google engineers describe Google's internal build system, a unified, language-agnostic system used across the company. It was presented as a 2012 NYC tech talk.
why: Referenced as a rare public description of how Google builds software, from which tools like Bazel descend.

quote.text: there is an interesting video "Building Software at Google Scale" [1], which seems to give an overview of the systems used.
